run_rl_evaluation: run the reinforcement learning evaluation script with an actor-only model loaded from environment config
create_evaluator: create an Evaluator instance with stats disabled to evaluate a reinforcement learning policy
load_env_with_overrides: load a reinforcement learning environment using load_env with actor_only override and evaluator
register_actor_callback: register an actor callback function with the game controller to process batches and return replies
run_eval_iterations: run evaluation iterations using EvalIters to step through the game loop until completion
